description: This bar chart, titled “PHHEME” on the left and “PolitiFact” on the right, compares the accuracy percentages of a model across five different configurations for each dataset. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5, with gridlines at each step. The horizontal axis lists the five configurations: “Ours”, “w/o comments”, “w/o text”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, and “w/o cognition”, arranged in a consistent order across both charts. In the PHHEME chart, the “Ours” configuration achieves the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by “w/o comments” at 86.82%, “w/o text” at 80.10%, “w/o select” at 88.80%, “w/o emotion” at 87.34%, and “w/o cognition” at 87.17%. In the PolitiFact chart, “Ours” achieves the highest accuracy at 90.57%, followed by “w/o comments” at 85.85%, “w/o text” at 83.02%, “w/o select” at 89.62%, “w/o emotion” at 84.91%, and “w/o cognition” at 87.74%. Each bar is color-coded: “Ours” is dark red, “w/o comments” is brown, “w/o text” is beige, “w/o select” is light gray, “w/o emotion” is teal, and “w/o cognition” is dark blue. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and height. The chart visually demonstrates the performance of the model under different feature ablation conditions for each dataset.
